# Thematiq

> Nextcloud app that applies an organisation's house style (NL Design System token sets, La Suite numerique and custom sets) to every Nextcloud screen, edited live from one admin settings page.

PHP backend with a vanilla JavaScript admin panel. The app id is `thematiq`; the `--nldesign-*` CSS properties belong to the NL Design System and keep their names.
